verdict.rationale: The pack shows only that billing is based on data ingest, with a 100 GB/month free tier. No evidence documents a usage or spend view, attribution of ingest or cost to teams or services, or alerting on ingest spikes. Generic NRQL alerts and the 'multi-cloud and Kubernetes spend' claim cover infrastructure cost, not observability spend, so they are not credited. Community reports of unexpected ingest increases suggest usage surprises but do not document any capability either way.
